summary: A Yes vote renews the expiring $148 annual parcel tax and adds a $40 increase to fund school programs.

tax.text: A Yes vote renews the expiring $148 school parcel tax and adds a $40 increase for nine years to fund local schools.
tax.quote: renewing the expiring $148 annual school parcel tax with a $40 increase, for nine years, with senior exemptions

schools.text: Measure P renews and raises the district's parcel tax to fund Tahoe-Truckee Unified public school programs, teachers, and class sizes, and a Yes vote supports it.
schools.quote: continue supporting math, science, engineering, technology, arts, and skilled trades/job training programs preparing students for success in college/careers
